title: HtmlScript
responsibility: Renders the native script element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlScript.attributes
inputs.description: Native script attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlScript.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native script element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlScript
outputs.description: The actual native script element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
